guitar.notes: Will Sergeant is well known for using Fender Telecasters and Stratocasters with chorus/effects-driven post-punk tone.

tone.target: dark chiming post-punk clean with spacey delay
tone.profile: dark chiming post-punk clean with spacey delay
tone.summary: A bright, vintage British clean tone (AC30 style) combined with chorus for jangle, followed by a subtle overdrive boost and heavy use of digital delay and plate reverb to create the signature spacey post-punk atmosphere.

rig.name: Echo And The Bunnymen - The Killing Moon - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Subtly lift the signal and add a touch of sparkle for chime.
blocks.gap: The Boost module is used to simulate the subtle grit/edge breakup required without adding heavy distortion.

blocks.purpose: Keep the tone clean and focused on natural harmonics.
blocks.gap: The 'None' setting is used to ensure maximum clarity and avoid unwanted coloration or crunch.

blocks.purpose: Provide the required bright, chimey, vintage British clean tone (Vox AC30 style).
Complement the vintage British sound and provide a balanced frequency response.
blocks.gap: While not strictly AC30 specific, this cabinet complements the bright UK tone well.

blocks.purpose: Create the signature 'jangle' and subtle movement required for post-punk clean tones.
blocks.gap: The Chorus module is used to achieve the desired modulation effect, simulating a chorus pedal.

blocks.purpose: Brighten the high end and slightly scoop the low-mids to enhance chime without losing warmth.
blocks.gap: Fine-tuning the EQ is necessary to achieve the specific 'chiming' quality of the source material.

blocks.purpose: Provide the signature spacey echo and rhythmic texture.
Add deep, spacious reverb to create the necessary atmospheric depth.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet IR to better match the vintage British chime required for post-punk.

proposals.reason: Enhance the specific bright, chiming character of a Vox/AC30 sound.
